dialogues.speaker: Jami
dialogues.text: I don't have any more of it. I gave all I had to you, and it would be a pain to make more...

dialogues.speaker: Jami
dialogues.text: You know, I did always think that there were maybe two steps too many in the production process. I omitted them this time, and the result seems to actually have improved...

dialogues.speaker: Jami
dialogues.text: Eh? Why didn't I make that my research topic instead...? ... Agh!

dialogues.speaker: Jami
dialogues.text: Curses! There's... there's no time to change topics now, is there!?
